news.contents: Corey Kiner carried the ball 10 times for 25 yards in a 35-10 loss to the Lions in Munich in Week 10.

news.analysis: Washington surprised in this game, throwing a beautiful deep touchdown pass to Jalen Tolbert on a trick play. He finished second on the team in receptions and second in receiving yards on the day, and could be a PPR-flex option next week against the Bills.
news.contents: Malik Washington caught all three of his targets for 50 yards and also threw a 34-yard touchdown in the Dolphins' 24-22 loss to the Colts.

news.contents: Miami wide receiver Malik Washington put together another solid performance in Week 10, so he remains a possible streaming option in standard fantasy leagues, along with being a good deep-league option. He was targeted three times against the Colts this past week - he made three grabs for 50 yards. Washington also threw a 34-yard touchdown to finish with an even better fantasy score. The wideout has 400 receiving yards and a touchdown across 36 receptions and 51 targets in his nine games played...
news.title: Malik Washington Gains Fantasy Appeal After Week 10

news.analysis: One week after a tremendous, season-best performance, Boutte virtually disappeared from the box score Sunday afternoon. Boutte has made some plays for the Texans this season, including a pair of touchdowns in Week 9, but he's difficult to deploy in fantasy lineups due to an unreliable target share.
news.contents: Kayshon Boutte failed to catch his only target in Sunday's 27-24 loss to the Browns.

news.contents: AJ Barner caught 3-of-3 targets for 19 yards in the Seahawks 21-13 win over the Raiders.

news.analysis: McPherson scored seven points on Sunday night. He wasn't perfect, however, as he left three points on the field by missing one of his two field-goal attempts over the course of the game. He should continue to be a good fantasy option for the time being.
news.contents: Evan McPherson went 5-for-5 on his extra-point attempts and 1-for-2 on his field-goal attempts in Sunday's 38-18 win over the Pittsburgh Steelers.

news.analysis: Meyers didn't see a lot of work on Sunday, but he was still able to leave his mark on the game by catching a touchdown on one of his two receptions. Fantasy managers shouldn't have high expectations for him moving forward, however.
news.contents: Dohnte Meyers caught two passes for 20 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 38-18 win over the Pittsburgh Steelers.
news.title: Dohnte Meyers scores once in win Sunday

news.contents: Baltimore Ravens wide receiver Rashod Bateman has struggled to make much of an impact as of late. Over the last four games, Bateman has recorded four receptions for 61 yards and zero touchdowns. The Ravens have lost two starting quarterbacks recently, so that hasn't helped their offense. The hope is that newly acquired Jacoby Brissett will help stabilize this offense against the Los Angeles Chargers' defense in Week 10. The 25-year-old former first-rounder from TCU enters Monday night's Week 10 road matchup against the Baltimore Ravens with only 13 receptions on 30 targets for 260 yards and one touchdown in seven games played. news.analysis: Darnold has missed the last two games with a quad injury he suffered in Week 8 against the Bears, after also playing through a cracked rib. With Seattle on bye in Week 11, the extra week gives him more time to heal. Darnold could return as a QB2 against San Francisco if he practices fully next week. Lock remains a stash in superflex and 2QB leagues until Darnold's status is confirmed.
news.contents: Seahawks head coach Mike Macdonald told Seattle Sports radio hosts Brock Huard and Mike Salk on Monday that the team is "really optimistic" QB Sam Darnold (quad) will get enough practice reps next week to start Nov. 29 against the 49ers, according to ESPN's Brady Henderson. Macdonald said Drew Lock has been great, "but Sam's our quarterback."
news.title: Sam Darnold could return in Week 12

news.contents: Seattle Seahawks head coach Mike Macdonald said on Monday that the team is "really optimistic" that quarterback Sam Darnold (quadriceps, ribs) will be able to get enough practice reps next week after Seattle's bye to start on Sunday, Nov. 29, versus the division-rival San Francisco 49ers, according to Brady Henderson of ESPN. The Virginia Tech product has not been as effective as Brian Robinson (hamstring) was as the team's secondary option at running back, and figures to have a limited role again in Week 10 in a home matchup against the Chiefs. news.contents: Cade Klubnik completed 11-of-20 pass attempts for 137 yards and an interception in the loss to Buffalo. He rushed for 26 yards on three carries.
news.title: Cade Klubnik tosses interception in Week 10

news.analysis: Washington saw eight carries to Ashton Jeanty's nine carries on a day where they were both once again shut down on the ground. He remains a volatile flex play.
news.contents: Mike Washington Jr. ran for 23 yards on eight carries in the Raiders 21-13 loss against the Seahawks. He also caught his lone target for four yards receiving.
news.title: Mike Washington Jr. shut down Sunday

news.contents: Las Vegas Raiders running back Mike Washington Jr. rushed eight times for 23 yards in Sunday's 21-13 loss to Seattle. He also caught one pass for four yards. Ashton Jeanty struggled as well, finishing with 18 yards on nine carries. Washington has seen opportunities in the Raiders' backfield, including a 25-carry performance against the Jets in Week 8, but his workload has been less substantial since then. He also hasn't been much of a factor in the passing game, limiting his appeal in PPR ...
